translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

book.name: MAGA
book.title: Maga Magahanda Bi Mana Debene gili binigo ogo

content: Yasuhanda agali mbiraha dama daraga ho hearia wara tagi henego ogo
Yasubi ibunaga talima piaga biarubi ti iba Galili ange edeyagi pialu Gerasa dindi anda pene.
Yasu ibu iba talu ngelalu pialu hearia agali mbira dama daragahe egeanda homali wiaruha henego ibalu hearia lola hene.
Agali biago ibu homali hearuha haabo haga hene. Mbiralime ibunaga gi gebi seni pume minu huba bibe nahe hene.
Tigua ibu gi gebi seni pume huba bu wiaabo hayagola ibugua seni pu tongo laabo haga hene. Ani henego tigua ibu mo tabila habe naheyagola helene.
Agali ogoni ibu horombe mbiragabi homali kagoriabi dindi hombenehabi ibaga bialu ga̱ lalu areme ibunaga tingini podalu haga hene.
Ani bialu hagago Yasu kaundiani ibiyaria hondowa ibu gerai lalu Yasu hearia ibuwa ge duli hanga howa bulu palene.
Ani buwa bi dalimu ga̱ lowa lalu, Ngode Datagaliwabe Daligaorene Daliga Kagonaga Igini Yasu í̠na i̱hondo agi bule ibiribe. Ngode Datagaliwabe mitangi bialu i̱hondo pani nangibe, lene.
Bi layago irane Yasuhanda damahondo, Tagira pu, lalu heaore ani ladai bini.
Yasuhanda ibuhondo lalu, Í̠ mini aibe, lene. Ibugua ladai bialu lalu, I̱ mini Dewa ina dewali kamago, lene.
Ani lowa ibugua Yasuhondo hongo howa laabo halu lalu, Ina dindi ogo wahalu pudaba nalabe, lene.
Nogo dewaore bare kawareni pi̱a̱ nalu bu hene.
Anigo dama daraga ho hayarume Yasuhondo hongo howa lalu, Ina nogo na̱i̱ karuha anda pu holoma̱ya pudaba la, lalu lai hene.

Yasuhanda, Ani bidaba, layagola agali helalu dama biarume tagira pialu nogo dewa daosini kira agima (2,000) hayaruha anda pene. Anda piyagola nogo bibahende hayaru bareni dalipebe bialu dai lo yalu pialu iba timbuniore bereagoha anda piai hayagola ibame nogo biaru nai hene.
Ani biyagola nogo haru haga hearume gerai lalu pialu tanohabi dindi anda bu wiaruhabi lopebe bima pene. O layago hale howa wali agali bu hearume agi biyadabe hondole pene.
Ti Yasu hearia ibuwa agali ala dama dewa daragahe hayago aga karulowa ibu mini bayale wia dai bu bereago de hondowa ti bibahende gi hai hene.
Maru handayarume wali agali íbu hearu hale helo dama dewa wara tagi hayarubi nogo ibaha puwa homayarubi te lalu lamiai hene.
Ani lamiyagola tigua Yasuhondo lalu, Í̠ inanaga dindi ogoriani nahe wahalu pu, lene.
Ogonidagua laya handala Yasu ibu iba taluni birule biyaria agali ala dama dewa daragahe hayagome ibuhondo lalu, Í̠ poredagua mba, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda agali biago ibuhondo lalu, I̱ heba pobe nahedago Anduane Homogohanda í̠hondo biyagobi dara hayagobi í̠ damene lamule andaga pu, lene.
Ani layagola agali biagome Tano Pira wiaruha lamima ibaga bialu Yasuhanda ibuhondo biyago wali agali hearuhondo lamiai hayagola ti minime mogo lai hene.
Yairasa wanebi wali Yasunaga agani ela hayagobi dabi henego ogo
Yasu iba taluni biralu iba timbuniore domalu dai buwa ibu iba angeni hearia wali agali dewa íbu ngoai hene.
Ani ngoai hayagola ngoai hagane anda hondo haga mbira mini Yairasa ibuwa Yasu de handalu ibu geha bulu palialu
hongo howa ibuhondo lalu, I̱ wane emene mbira homolene kaware ngago ibu nahome dabi helo í̠naga gime ela habelo mba, lene.
Ani lowa libu haru pialu hearia wali agali dewa hearu Yasu haruru pialu gengeda tago bima pene.
Pialu hearia wali mbira mali pira mbirani kira (12) warago taraore baabo haga berene.
Ibugua anogoda agali dewaoreme handalu ibunaga muni yolo bialu biyagola miai howa dabi nahe warago íbu timbuore hene.
Ani biruwa Yasuhanda mo dabi haga ka layago hale howa ibu wali agali Yasu haruru piyaru heba pene.
Ala ibuni hangu lo manda bialu, I̱na Yasunaga agani ela haruyagua dabi holebero, manda bini.
Ibugua Yasunaga agani ela hayagola warago bayago abaleore ereba halu ibunaga tingini dabi haiore hayada manda bini.
Anidagua biyagola Yasu ibunaga mo dabi haga hongo piayuago manda buwa ibu beregedalu lalu, I̱naga agani ela haya aiwabe, lene.
Ani layagola ibunaga talima piaga biarume ibuhondo lalu, Wali agali dewali gengeda tago bu kamago de hendedego. Aiwa ela hayabe larigo aginaga laribe, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda aiwa ela hayabe hondole handa de̱le̱ bini.
Wali biagome warago dabi hayago manda buwa gi howa duru lalu Yasu hearia ibini. Ibuwa ibu geha bulu paluwa bibahende ibuni biyago lamiai hene.
Ani lamiai hayagola Yasuhanda ibuhondo lalu, I̱ wane-o í̠na Ngode Datagaliwabehondo mini mbiraore wirigome í̠ mo dabi hayago ai warago lone naboleberego mo palia holene karulo yalu pu, lene.
Yasuhanda wali biagohondo bi lamialu heaore agali maru hondo haga Yairasa ibunaga andaga howa ibini. Ibuwa tigua lalu, Í̠ wane biago tongo lo miyago ai Lawai Haga kago la pugu nabibe, lene.
Tigua bi ani layagola hale howa Yasuhanda hondo haga Yairasahondo lalu, Gi nahe Ngode Datagaliwabehondo mini mbiraore wibe, lene.
Ani lowa wali agali maru hearu helalu Yasuhanda Pida Yamese ibu hamene Yonema tihondo, Ina hangu hondo maibidaba, lene.
Hondo haga agali biagonaga andaga anda pialu hearia wali agali dewa ngoai ho hearume bi lagalaga bialu dugu timbuni bialu hearia Yasu ibu handa walia hene.
Handa walia howa ibu anda tamuha puwa tihondo lalu, Tí aginaga bi laga bialu dugu timbuni bialu kamibe. Wandari emene ogoni ibu tongolo mia nabi palia dege bida, lene.
Ani layagola tigua Yasuhondo oba halu hene. Ani biyagola ibugua ti bibahende wara tagi howa wandari ai̱ya ababi agali tebira biarubi ti haru hobane mbiraha wandari moa heagoria pene.
Yasuhanda wandari biago gini yamuwa ibuhondo lalu, Talita kumi, inanaga bi lalu, Wandari emene heya laro, lene.
Ani layaore wandari biago heyalu ibaga bini. Wandari ogoni ibu mali pira mbirani kira (12) berene. Ani biyagola wali agali hearume handawa bialu mogo timbuniore lai hene.
Yasuhanda tihondo hongo howa lalu, O birudagoni wali agali mbirali nalamilimu, lowa lalu, Wandari ogoni tomo nelo midaba, lene.
